tasks.label: Render blog(1) HTML+PDF to blog(1) folder
args: cd /d quarto && quarto render blog1.qmd --to html --output blog1.html && quarto render blog1.qmd --to pdf --output blog1.pdf && if not exist "..\blog\css" mkdir "..\blog\css" && copy /y "..\css\style.css" "..\blog\css\style.css" && copy /y "..\css\quarto.css" "..\blog\css\quarto.css" && copy /y "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.html" "..\blog\blog(1)\blog(1).html" && copy /y "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.pdf" "..\blog\blog(1)\blog(1).pdf" && if exist "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.html" del /q "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.html" && if exist "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.pdf" del /q "..\blog\blog(1)\blog1.pdf"
